channel.title: OakFox Journal
channel.description: Articles on sustainability, branding, design, and development from OakFox — a sustainable design studio in West Lancashire, UK.

item.title: Why Most Small Businesses Shouldn't Self-Host on Cloudflare Pages (Even Though It's Free)
item.description: Cloudflare Pages is the cheapest, fastest, greenest static host going. So why do most small businesses get bitten by it? Where the free tier wins, and where managed green hosting earns its keep.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: Building CubTrack: Designing a Calm Baby Tracking App for UK Parents
item.description: How we built CubTrack, a baby tracking app for Android — the brand decisions, UX choices for one-handed use at 3am, the Android stack, and what we learned shipping a freemium product end-to-end.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: What a Preliminary Ecological Appraisal Actually Contains — and Why Most Take Six Weeks Longer Than They Should
item.description: A clear walk-through of what goes into a Preliminary Ecological Appraisal (PEA), the parts that genuinely require an ecologist's judgement, and the parts quietly eating most of the budget on every job.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: How to Write Sustainability Claims That Aren't Greenwashing
item.description: A practical guide to writing sustainability claims that hold up to scrutiny — under UK CMA guidance, EU Green Claims Directive, and basic customer trust. With real examples of what to say, what not to say, and why.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: Why BNG is Burying Small Ecological Consultancies in Paperwork
item.description: Biodiversity Net Gain is a good policy with a quiet side effect: it's crushing the small ecological consultancies doing most of the careful work. Here's what's happening, and why it matters.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: Sustainable Web Design: A Practical Guide for UK Businesses
item.description: What sustainable web design actually means, how much energy your website uses, and the specific changes that cut emissions — with real numbers, not marketing lines.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: Green Web Hosting UK Compared (2026)
item.description: A practical comparison of verified renewable-powered web hosting providers serving the UK market in 2026. Prices, data centre locations, performance, and honest caveats.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: The Future of Sustainability in Branding and Marketing
item.description: Sustainability isn't a trend — it's becoming the baseline. Here's how branding and marketing are shifting, and what it means for businesses that want to stay relevant.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: Choosing a Brand Name: A Practical Process (With Real Examples)
item.description: How to choose a brand name that works commercially and legally. The process we use at OakFox — with a checklist, worked examples, and the mistakes to avoid.
item.author: OakFox

item.title: How to Brief a Branding Agency (Without Wasting Anyone's Time)
item.description: A practical guide to writing a brief that gets you a better proposal, a better quote, and a better project. With the questions to answer, the mistakes to avoid, and a template you can actually use.
item.author: OakFox
